entries.cow: place cards on the board. Use the letters to spell: cow
entries.box: nice! Try this one next: box
entries.herd:
excellent! Let's up the difficulty: herd 
 Try combining a Cow card with a Cow on the board.
entries.forge:
awesome! Next word: forge 
 Hint: objects on the board will shake if they can be combined with your held card
entries.inferno:
one final, very useful word: inferno 
 (Combine it with almost any other card to destroy it)
entries.ok:
great work! You can keep track of discovered cards and combos in the Dex (via main and pause menus). 
 Check out endless and the daily packs for more words to try!
